zh: CID：替代五元组的连接标识。
connection_id(54)：协商该扩展的 TLS 扩展号。
tls12_cid(25)：带 CID 的记录内容类型。
NAT 重绑定：端点地址在会话中途改变。
DTLSInnerPlaintext：把真实类型与填充封进密文的结构。
可达性校验：换址前确认新地址能收包。
en: CID: a connection identifier replacing the five-tuple.
connection_id(54): the extension type used to negotiate it.
tls12_cid(25): the record content type that carries a CID.
NAT rebinding: the peer address changes mid-session.
DTLSInnerPlaintext: real type and padding sealed inside the ciphertext.
Reachability check: confirming the new address can receive before switching.
